name: croatian-web-copywriting
description: Natural, native-sounding Croatian website copy: headlines, CTAs, microcopy and meta text that don't read as translated from English.

interface.shortDescription: Croatian website copy that doesn't read as translated.
interface.longDescription: Writes and edits short-form website copy in natural, native-sounding Croatian: hero headlines, taglines, calls to action, buttons, value propositions, form microcopy, error and empty states, 404 pages, meta titles and descriptions. No Title Case, no calqued slogans, one consistent Vi/ti register.
defaultPrompt: Napiši hero naslov i CTA za naslovnu stranicu računovodstvenog ureda.
Prevedi ovaj landing na hrvatski tako da ne zvuči prevedeno.
Popravi tekst na ovim gumbima i porukama o greškama u formi.
